sermon.title: What Happens to Unfruitful People? 08/19/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer returns to Satan’s secret weapons and the parable of the sower to ask what happens to unfruitful people. Not sinning is required behavior, not good fruit; branches without fruit are cut off, but God’s refining fire and the hammer of His word burn away impurities and give beauty for ashes.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: He cites “Isaiah 51:3” for beauty for ashes (Isaiah 61:3) and “Psalms 139” for lifting the needy from the ash heap (Psalm 113:7); his words kept, the correct passages linked. Unverified historical claims (Supreme Court “1898” separate-but-equal ruling; science department in Washington requiring evolution in 1960) are kept as spoken.

chunks.section_question: What does it mean that the axe is laid to the root?

chunks.section_question: What is the invitation at the close?
chunks.short_answer: Let the Holy Spirit show you what needs to change and accept His refining fire and the hammer of His word. If you have never accepted Christ, admit you are a sinner and ask Him to forgive you.

faqs.question: How does he describe his own hard head?
faqs.answer: God had to hit him with a spiritual 2x4.

faqs.question: Is money the root of all evil?
faqs.answer: No, the love of money is.

faqs.question: Are you responsible for your family’s choices?
faqs.answer: No; everybody goes into the holy of holies one at a time.

faqs.question: Who gets rich in prosperity megachurches?
Does having a Bible on the table change you?
faqs.answer: No; there is no osmosis, it takes work.

faqs.question: What did Jesus ask about calling Him Lord?
faqs.answer: Why call Him Lord and not do what He says?

scriptures.text_nkjv: “But why do you call Me ‘Lord, Lord,’ and not do the things which I say?

faqs.question: Does believing let you live the way you want?
faqs.answer: No; the Bible is about responsibility.
